title: Loaned-Out Item Return Aging
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), intake scans (`collection:scan`), market prices (`collection:price`), item photos (`collection:photo`), authentication records (`collection:auth`), loans (`collection:loan`), and condition audits (`collection:condition`).
app: Collection telemetry from personal catalogues, NFC scans, pricing feeds, authentication records, loan logs, shelf measurements, and item-condition audits streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:loan returned=0
| eval days_out=round((now()-loaned_at)/86400,1)
| sort - days_out
description: Ranks currently loaned items by how long they have been out of the collection.
value: Loan tracking prevents accidental loss and awkward memory-based follow-up when collectibles circulate among friends or family.
implementation: Capture item loans with a timestamp and mark them returned only when the item comes home.
visualization: Table of active loans by days out.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which items have been away from your collection the longest and may need chasing up.
